title: Marketing / Duo
slide_intent: Give a recognizable mascot expressive roles because repeated recognition is more useful when it can also communicate a feeling.
strategic_value: Duo’s green silhouette and varied poses can connect campaigns while expressing excitement, affection or sadness.
demonstration: Nine Duo expressions form a three-by-three array beside a description of his marketing role.
practical_value: Select a pose that supports the message or occasion instead of treating the mascot as a fixed stamp.

content_islands.name: Expression repertoire
content_islands.spec: Arrange the nine green owls on the pale panel with gestures and accents intact.

content_islands.name: Marketing role
content_islands.spec: Explain recognition, emotional range and special occasions at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source calls Duo the most recognizable brand element and connects that recognition to a starring marketing role.
reference_purposes.Application: It recommends using him for excitement, a range of emotions and special occasions such as Valentine’s Day.

ingredient.name: Duo in marketing
ingredient.application: Give Duo a prominent role where useful and select a pose for the emotion or occasion.
ingredient.scope: Historical marketing guidance; prominence is frequent rather than mandatory in every communication.
